title: Fractional Grönwall--Wendroff Inequalities for Implicit Systems with Distributed Memory
summary: This work establishes a comprehensive analytical framework for studying implicit fractional differential systems with distributed memory and time delays. We develop novel fractional integral inequalities of Grönwall--Wendroff type that are specifically adapted to handle multivariate functions with singular kernels and implicit dependencies. These inequalities provide essential a priori estimates for analyzing complex memory-dependent systems. Building upon these results, we prove general existence and uniqueness theorems for implicit fractional differential equations using fixed-point theory…
